Awesome-Jj: Jujutsu Things
item.description:
📝 awesome-jj Jujutsu (also known as jj) is a Git-compatible version control system. This repo contains a curated list of awesome articles, tutorials, videos, tools or other resources that are related to Jujutsu. Tutorials Official tutorial Steve Klabnik's tutorial "Jujutsu For Busy Devs" "Jujutsu for everyone" "Jujutsu VCS Introduction and Patterns" Posts about Jujutsu "why i think jj-vcs is worth your time" "I see a future in jj" "jj init" Videos about Jujutsu "JJ Con 2025" playlist "Jujutsu Megamerges & Git History Preview" @ GitButler Tools gg: GUI for jj jjui: TUI for jj Jujutsu Kaizen: jj support for VS Code lazyjj: TUI for jj Selvejj: jj integration into JetBrains IDEs Communities IRC: #jujutsu on Libera Chat Discord Contributing Contributions are welcome.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/Necior/awesome-jj

item.title: Free Software Awards Winners Announced: Andy Wingo, Alx Sa, Govdirectory
item.description:
📝 Free Software Awards winners announced: Andy Wingo, Alx Sa, Govdirectory by Free Software Foundation Contributions — Published on Dec 09, 2025 08:53 AM BOSTON, Massachusetts, USA (Tuesday, December 9, 2025) — The Free Software Foundation (FSF) announced today the recipients of the 2024 Free Software Awards, which are given annually by the FSF to groups and individuals in the free software community who have made significant contributions to the cause for software freedom. This year's Free Software Awards recipients are Andy Wingo, Alx Sa, and Govdirectory. Media Contacts Greg Farough Campaigns Manager Free Software Foundation +1 (617) 542 5942 campaigns@fsf.
🔗 Read more: https://www.fsf.org/news/2024-free-software-awards-winners

item.title: Some surprising things about DuckDuckGo
item.description:
📝 The plurality of our search traffic now comes from our own browsers. Yes, we have our own browsers with our search engine built in along with a ton of other protections. com search domain that automatically sets those settings for you, including a recent setting we added that allows you to hide many AI-generated images within image search.
🔗 Read more: https://gabrielweinberg.com/p/some-surprising-things-about-duckduckgo
